description: Assemble this workspace's creative assets (clips, stills, a voice-over, music, sound effects) into one finished vertical video (9:16, 4:5 or 1:1) or a feed still: voice-synced captions inside the platform's safe zone, the product's brand colours and font, music under the voice, SFX on the cuts and an optional end card. Up to 12 segments, 60 seconds and 6 SFX; every asset must belong to the same product. Set draft: true for a lower-priced 540-wide preview. music may be {assetId} or {source: "stock", query} for free stock music. The first call is a free price quote in credits for one flat render; nothing is charged until you confirm. Show the user the credits and ask before calling again with the same arguments plus confirm: true and the confirmationToken, then poll creative_job_status. The result is a composite asset; it never publishes. Use when the user has generated clips, images or audio and wants them cut into one post.

briefId.description: Optional. The id of the creative brief this is for, from creative_brief_list. Leave it out when there is none, as for a request made in chat.

captions.description: "voiceover" (from the voice-over's word timings; the default when one is given), "none", or your own lines with start/end in seconds.

confirm.description: Set true only once the user has agreed to the quoted credits.

assetId.description: A music asset id, from creative_music or creative_assets_list.
An asset id, from creative_assets_list or the creative tool that made it.
A sound-effect asset id, from creative_sfx or creative_assets_list.

voiceoverAssetId.description: Optional. A voice-over asset id, from creative_voiceover or creative_assets_list.

name: creative_compose

confirmationToken.description: Pass this back with confirm: true to start the render.

quote.description: First call: what the render will cost. Nothing was rendered or charged yet.

title: Compose Video
